desc:
Email and SMS list setup for online stores connects your store, signup forms and sending tool so every subscriber lands in the right place. Ecom Swift LLC builds the sync, consent fields and tags in your own account and tests it with real signups.

## What is an email and SMS list setup?

An email and SMS list setup is the groundwork that decides who can be contacted, how, and with what details attached. It links your store and forms to your email or SMS tool, creates lists or groups, records consent and source, and imports past contacts correctly.

Everything you send later rests on it. If the data is wrong, campaigns reach the wrong people or miss the right ones.

## Why clean data is the base of every campaign

Many stores collect contacts for years without a plan. Customers from checkout sit in one place, a popup adds people elsewhere, an old spreadsheet holds more, and nobody knows who agreed to what. The result is duplicates, missing consent, wrong names in greetings and subscribers who receive the same message twice.

A tidy setup solves these problems before they appear. When each person has a record, a consent status and a source, you can send relevant messages, honor unsubscribes at once and explain where each contact came from. It also keeps later work, such as welcome flows and segments, simple, because the fields they need already exist.

## What a well-built list setup includes

- A live connection between your store and your email or SMS tool for customers and orders.
- One main list with clear consent fields for email and, where used, text messages.
- Separate lists or groups only where there is a real reason, such as wholesale customers.
- Source tags showing which form, page or checkout step each person came from.
- Custom fields for details you will actually use, such as preferred category or birthday month.
- A tidy import of older contacts, with duplicates and invalid addresses removed.
- Unsubscribe, suppression and bounce settings checked.
- Sender name and reply address set so messages look familiar.
- A test signup and a test order to prove the data flows.
- A one-page map saying which list holds which people and why.

## How we do it

We start by looking at where your contacts come from today: checkout, forms, imports and any older tools. Then we connect your store to the sending tool, create the list structure and set the consent and unsubscribe options. We tag each signup form with its source.

Basic covers one tool, one main list, synced customers and orders, and a test. Standard adds up to three lists or groups, source tags, a contact import and consent checks. Premium adds more lists, a larger import, custom fields, clean-up of duplicates and bounces, and a handover call. Past contacts are only imported when there is a record that you may email them, and we ask you where that permission came from. This service sets up the base; it does not send campaigns.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep one main list and add groups only when needed.
- Record how and when each person agreed.
- Use clear field names that your whole team understands.
- Test with a fresh email address before going live.
- Back up your old contact file before an import.

**Avoid:**
- Importing purchased or scraped addresses.
- Mixing customers and subscribers without labels.
- Creating a new list for every campaign idea.
- Collecting fields you will never use.
- Adding people to text lists from an email-only opt-in.

## Who it is for

A new store opening its first list will get a clean foundation. A seller moving from one email tool to another can bring contacts across without losing consent records. A store with years of scattered contacts can tidy them before building automations.

## What to send us

Tell us your store platform, the tool you want to use, the forms you have and where past contacts are stored. Share a contact file if you plan an import. We never need your store login or password. Access is given to us as a collaborator, staff or team user, and you stay the owner of every account.
